first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: teal stadium seating
entities.identification: Large sections of teal seats arranged in stepped tiers, with gray stairs and passageways between sections.

entities.name: stadium roof and trusses
entities.identification: The light-colored canopy above the stands, together with repeated beams, diagonal braces, and segmented roof surfaces.

entities.name: pink-purple illuminated racing gate set
entities.identification: A set of racing gates with light-colored frames and pink-purple illuminated edges, including the near gate approached in the earlier portion and the distant sideline gates; excludes Object M.

entities.name: green stadium turf
entities.identification: The open, approximately planar green area in the center of the stadium, with light yellow-brown areas in places.

entities.name: gray sideline passageway
entities.identification: The narrow, elongated light-gray paved surface extending between the turf and the stands.

entities.name: Object M
entities.identification: A tower-shaped racing gate at the sideline with segmented cyan-blue illuminated columns and white-pink upper components.

entities.name: stadium floodlight strip
entities.identification: Rows of bright white lights repeatedly arranged along the edge of the roof.

entities.name: upper-level black display screen
entities.identification: A black screen surface with a bright, light-colored graphic above an elevated platform.

entities.name: platform below the display screen
entities.identification: A gray horizontal platform structure below the upper-level black display screen.

entities.name: light-colored railing
entities.identification: Light-colored horizontal rails and spaced vertical posts arranged along the edges of the platform, seating sections, and stand passageways.

entities.name: illuminated direction marker
entities.identification: Yellow or pink-purple short strip-shaped fixed illuminated markers near the route.

entities.name: teal low sideline wall
entities.identification: A low teal strip-like structure extending along the boundary between the near edge of the field and the seating.
